title: Control origami — evidence sketch and open questions
body:
Quick context:
I started folding small chunks of evidence into this scratch doc so we have a compact view to hand off to audit. Not polished — this is a working brain-dump that mixes concrete evidence locations with questions I still have. Use this to triage what we can attach to the SOC2 pack and what needs remediation work or annotations for the auditor.

Top-level goals (what I want from this doc):
- Produce a slim list of 30–40 evidentiary items we can reasonably collect in the next 2 weeks.
- Annotate each item with the owner + where it lives (S3 path / console screenshot / link to runbook).
- Call out hazards: items that are insufficient as-is and what remediation or context to attach.

High-level control mapping notes (preliminary):
- Logical access (IAM): maps to CC6. Evidence candidates: IAM role policy snapshots, admin role separation doc, last 30 days of user console access logs.
  - Evidence: s3://redwood-evidence/iam/policies-2026-02-28.json (exported via infra script)
  - Owner: Eli T.
  - Hazards: we need a concise narrative explaining exception for service accounts that have broad scope (PR 487 pending).

- Key management & encryption: maps to CC3/CC6. Evidence: KMS key rotation log; TLS cert renewal records; disk encryption configs for dedicated GPU hosts.
  - Evidence: aws-kms:alias/redwood-inference-primary (rotation date 2025-11-01), /ops/certs/renewal-history.md
  - Owner: Maya L.
  - Hazards: on-prem package uses local HSM in some customers; we need policy stating when HSM vs KMS is used and who approves keys.

- Change management & deployment: maps to CC7. Evidence: release checklist, CI job logs for prod deploys, PR sign-off policy.
  - Evidence: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions?workflow=prod-deploy (link in confluence), release-checklist-prod.md
  - Owner: Runa (me) + infra eng oncall (TBD)
  - Hazards: we do a fair bit of hotfixing in emergencies; need a retrospective note or exception log for each hotfix with approvals.

- Logging, monitoring, alerting: maps to CC6/CC7. Evidence: centralized logging retention policy, alert runbook, sample pager duty incidents.
  - Evidence: /ops/observability/alert-runs/incident-2026-01-19.md; grafana-dashboard-export.json
  - Owner: Observability team (Victor)
  - Hazards: retention policy doc is vague on long-term archival for dedicated/private customers — attach customer SLA excerpt or dataflow note.

- Vendor & third-party controls: maps to CC2. Evidence: vendor inventory, security questionnaires.
  - Evidence: vendors.csv (drive) + completed security questionnaire for cloud provider (confluence link)
  - Owner: procurement / legal (Samira)
  - Hazards: some marketplace partners are still onboarding; ensure we have completed questionnaires or temporary risk assessments.

Open questions I flagged (actionable):
1) Evidence granularity for ephemeral infra: how deep do auditors expect snapshots (terraform state vs runtime AWS console screenshots)? Quick ask: Eli to sync with auditor and capture exact examples. TODO: send RFC to auditor with 3 sample artifacts.
2) On-prem/private deployment logs: customers often ship logs to their own Splunk. What do we show as platform evidence vs delegated responsibility? Need a short explanatory note in evidence pack.
3) KMS vs HSM policy: who signs off on HSM usage? Add a short policy doc and a named approver.
4) Hotfix exception records: we have GH issues and postmortems but not a dedicated hotfix approval trail. Can we create a lightweight template for the next 6 months and retroactively attach to previous hotfixes?

Evidence harvest checklist (practical):
- [ ] Export admin-policy snapshots (IAM) for last 90 days (Eli)
- [ ] Pull KMS rotation logs and attach alias/ARN (Maya)
- [ ] Export three prod deploy CI runs showing approvals (Runa)
- [ ] Build one-page runbook: "how to collect evidence for audit" and share with Eng leads (Runa + Victor)
- [ ] Collect 2 sample on-prem config bundles from Solutions Eng for private customers (Solutions Eng)
- [ ] Draft exception narrative for service account wide permissions (Eli + Runa)

Quick evidence index (candidate items with comment):
- IAM policies export — s3://redwood-evidence/iam/policies-2026-02-28.json — good, but needs summary doc mapping policy -> business role.
- KMS key rotation log — console export 2025–2026 — OK, need approver signature line on policy.
- Release checklist artifacts — github PRs #1203, #1289 — include approval comment screenshots.
- Incident runbook + sample pagerduty fire (2026-01-19) — good, but link to RCA for that incident is missing.
- On-prem packaging manifest for customer ACME — solutions-eng/ACME/manifest-2025-10.txt — we need to redact customer PII and note where responsibility shifts.

Draft control narrative snippets (useful for evidence readme):
- "Access control: Administrative access is limited to a small group of named administrators. IAM policies are versioned and exported monthly; emergency role usage is logged and reviewed in a monthly access review meeting." (Need: attendee list + minutes)
- "Key management: Primary encryption keys are managed in AWS KMS with automatic rotation. For customers requiring on-prem HSMs, keys are generated and controlled per customer contract with documented approvals." (Need: HSM approval workflow doc)

Notes-to-self / reminders:
- When assembling the zip for auditor, include a small README.md that explains contextual limits (e.g., private deployments where customer controls their logs). Make that one of the first files.
- Keep evidence filenames short; auditors hate long paths. e.g., iam-policies-2026-02.json, kms-rotation-2026-02.csv, deploy-ci-2026-01-12.log
- If we redact anything (customer names / IPs), produce a redaction log showing original -> redacted mapping stored separately to maintain audit trail.

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Eli: confirm auditor expectations re: terraform vs console screenshots (by 2026-03-05).
- Maya: export KMS rotation logs and cert renewals (by 2026-03-07).
- Runa: draft the 1-page evidence collection runbook and hotfix approval template (by 2026-03-08).
- Victor (observability): attach one sample dashboard export and retention policy excerpt (by 2026-03-09).

Random brain dump / scratch ideas (low priority):
- Could create a tiny internal "evidence gatherer" CLI that runs the exports and drops them into the s3 evidence bucket with metadata. MVP could be a shell script. Good follow-up for infra intern.
- Add a small section in onboarding that explains what counts as "audit-grade log" for engineers (timestamped, immutable export preferred).

References/links I keep hitting:
- Confluence control mapping v2: CONFLUENCE:trust/control-mapping-v2
- Auditor thread in Slack: slack://archives/C0SEC/14920323 (need to pin the message)
- GitHub PR about service-account scope: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/487

Unresolved (for next sync):
- Decide retention period we declare for access logs for hosted API vs dedicated stacks (standardize wording).
- Write a one-sentence policy for on-prem evidence limitations.

End — will iterate. If you look at this and think something should be promoted to the core evidence list, flag it in Slack and I'll move it to the top.

-- Runa
